productOverview: FieldSync Pro is a mobile-first, off-the-shelf field service management platform covering dispatch, scheduling, offline-capable technician mobile apps, work order management, and an AI assistant for job triage and parts lookup. Sold as a multi-tenant SaaS with native iOS/Android apps.
keyCapabilities: Drag-and-drop dispatch board with skill and location-based scheduling
Offline-first mobile app for technicians (photos, signatures, parts usage)
AI assistant for natural-language job search, triage suggestions, and parts lookup
Customer self-service booking portal and appointment reminders (SMS/email)
Inventory and truck-stock tracking with low-stock alerts
Open REST API and prebuilt connectors for common CRM/ERP systems
constraints: AI assistant requires at least 90 days of historical job data to reach recommended accuracy
Offline mobile sync limited to 7 days of queued changes before requiring a network sync
Multi-language support limited to English, Spanish, and French at GA
Custom workflow automation only available on the Growth and Enterprise plans
licensingModel: Per-technician-seat monthly subscription, tiered by plan (Starter/Growth/Enterprise), with optional add-ons billed separately.

security.encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit

pricing.model: Per-seat monthly subscription plus optional AI assistant and SMS add-ons

lineItems.notes: Includes data migration and dispatcher training
